parameters.content:
## Website Contact Page Email & Phone Crawler

**Actor:** [Website Contact Page Email & Phone Crawler](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/website-contact-page-email-and-phone-crawler)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/website-contact-page-email-and-phone-crawler.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `urls` (array, required)
- `maxPagesPerSite` (integer)
- `maxConcurrency` (integer)
- `maxSitesConcurrency` (integer)
- `requestTimeoutSecs` (integer)
- `defaultCountry` (string)
- `useProxy` (boolean)
- `smartPrioritise` (boolean)
- `respectRobotsTxt` (boolean)
- `useSitemap` (boolean)
- `renderFallback` (boolean)
- `onlyWithContacts` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `websiteUrl` (Website Url)
- `status` (Status)
- `companyName` (Company Name)
- `emails` (Emails)
- `primaryEmail` (Primary Email)
- `roleEmails` (Role Emails)
- `namedEmails` (Named Emails)
- `emailDetails` (Email Details)
- `phones` (Phones)
- `primaryPhone` (Primary Phone)
- `phoneDetails` (Phone Details)
- `socialLinks` (Social Links)

description: Find emails and phone numbers from a list of websites: runs the Website Contact Page Email & Phone Crawler Apify Actor, returns websiteUrl, status, emails, primaryEmail, phones and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
